sanskrit_verse: बिन्दुमात्रापदवर्णेष्व् एकाविधिष्टया (?) । हीनाधिका भवेद् व्यर्था तां यत्नेन विवर्जयेत् ॥
transliteration: bindumātrāpadavarṇeṣv ekāvidhiṣṭayā (?) | hīnādhikā bhaved vyarthā tāṃ yatnena vivarjayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In matters where the application of a single rule leads to deficiency or excess, thereby causing futility, such defective regulation must be conscientiously abandoned.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is realized through precision in dharma-application, not mechanical repetition.
Causation arises from alignment with conscious capacity, not external enforcement.
Capacity-based responsibility requires dynamic calibration, not static imposition.
Restoration logic demands elimination of futile regulatory constructs.
Consciousness alignment necessitates rejection of rules that distort natural order.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a legal rule produces hīna (deficiency) OR adhika (excess) THEN it SHALL BE marked as vyarthā (futile).
IF a rule is marked vyarthā THEN it SHALL NOT be enforced by any judicial or administrative system.
ALL legal enactments MUST undergo capacity-responsibility validation BEFORE implementation.
ANY rule producing distortion in alignment SHALL BE auto-retracted by the system within 1 operational cycle.
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudicators must reject laws that generate imbalance or redundancy. Judgment must proceed from recognition of vyarthā and align with precise dharmic calibration rather than inherited legislative form.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that defective rules cause misalignment; anupūrvaśaḥ shows their sequential harm; proportional responsibility lies in abandoning them; non-punitive reality demands cessation of futile enforcement, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vyarthā-Rule Audit Protocol upon detection of systemic inefficacy.
Activate Consciousness Calibration Review to restore alignment between law and dharma.
Deploy Rule Reintegration Sequence to replace defective formulations with precise axiomatic statements.
Execute Non-Punitive Nullification Process to dissolve harmful precedents without blame assignment.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: futile regulation is null, dharma is restored, reality is non-punitive, and consciousness remains the sole adjudicator.
